rule_metadata.author: Alejandro Ortuno, oscd.community, CheraghiMilad
rule_metadata.title: Local System Accounts Discovery Attempt - Linux

rules.rule_text:
title: Local System Accounts Discovery Attempt - Linux
id: b45e3d6f-42c6-47d8-a478-df6bd6cf534c
status: test
description: 'Detects attempts to enumerate local user accounts via common Linux utilities
  and sensitive file access.

  Adversaries may read files such as /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, and /etc/sudoers, or
  use tools like getent,

  id, who, and finger to identify accounts and privilege levels on a compromised system.

  '
references:
- https://github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team/blob/f339e7da7d05f6057fdfcdd3742bfcf365fee2a9/atomics/T1087.001/T1087.001.md
- https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K589
- https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?pwd_mkdb
- https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/getent.1.html
- https://linux.die.net/man/1/finger
author: Alejandro Ortuno, oscd.community, CheraghiMilad
date: 2020-10-08
modified: 2026-11-03
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1087.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_lastlog:
    Image|endswith:
    - /lastlog
    - /last
    - /lastb
  selection_root_string:
    CommandLine|contains: 'x:0:'
  selection_read_utilities:
    Image|endswith:
    - /cat
    - /ed
    - /emacs
    - /head
    - /less
    - /makemap
    - /more
    - /nano
    - /sqlite3
    - /tail
    - /vi
    - /vim
    CommandLine|contains:
    - /etc/passwd
    - /etc/shadow
    - /etc/sudoers
    - master.passwd
    - pwd.db
  selection_id:
    Image|endswith: /id
  selection_lsof:
    Image|endswith: /lsof
    CommandLine|contains: -u
  selection_getent:
    Image|endswith: /getent
    CommandLine|contains:
    - ' passwd'
    - ' shadow'
  selection_who:
    Image|endswith:
    - /finger
    - /users
    - /w
    - /who
  selection_ypcat:
    Image|endswith: /ypcat
    CommandLine|contains: passwd
  filter_optional_landscape_sysinfo:
    ParentCommandLine|contains: /usr/bin/landscape-sysinfo
    Image|endswith: /who
  condition: 1 of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administration activities
level: low
